title: When the Contact Burns
author: Cyrus Ravensworth
blurb: Juniper Ravensworth, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
